meta.name: aed:code-copy
meta.description: Mode selector. 'auto' wires every <pre><code> block on the page; 'opt-in' only wires <pre> elements that explicitly opt in.

data.description: Per-block control (only honored in 'auto' mode for opting OUT, or in 'opt-in' mode for opting IN).

data-aed-code-copy.description: 'off' suppresses the copy button on this block. (Or 'on' in opt-in mode.)

data-language.description: Override the language label rendered on the copy button.
